note: CENSUS-RUN.SH FAILS ON A PRUNABLE WORKTREE, AND THE ERROR DOES NOT SAY SO. The Ell, lefford, 2026-08-11: HV_CENSUS_WORKTREE=canonical died with fatal: cannot change to canonical: No such file or directory, after acquiring and releasing the lock. Cause: the existence check at census-run.sh:99 is [ -e t/.git ] OR git worktree list --porcelain | grep -qF t. A worktree whose DIRECTORY is gone but whose REGISTRATION survives is still printed by worktree list (flagged prunable), so the grep matches, the script takes the already-exists branch, and then cd fails. The check cannot distinguish exists from registered-but-pruned. Fix, and it is safe on a shared box because prune only drops metadata for directories that are already gone: git -C ~/Projects/hornvale worktree prune, verify worktree list, re-run. Check for the prunable flag in worktree list BEFORE dispatching; it is visible and I saw it and did not act on it.
